chow_liu_tree_structure.description: Tree edges/root selected by max-MI spanning tree on the fit data; defines both the sampler's factorization and the Fisher-score block structure.

conditional_probability_tables.description: Each edge CPT P(child|parent) is used both for ancestral/BP sampling and as the Fisher-score reference distribution for that node.

quantizer_bin_edges_and_levels.description: Discretization shared by geometry (Fisher score) and generation (ancestral/BP sampling).

root_marginal.description: P(root) used both as the generation root distribution and as the Fisher-score reference for the root block.
